title: Law to require trash containers for city buildings' waste
summary: This bill would direct the Department of Sanitation, working with the Department of Citywide Administrative Services and the Department of Education, to create a program requiring non-residential city-owned buildings to store and collect their waste in stationary on-street containers rather than loose bags. All covered city buildings would need to comply by June 1, 2030. The Department would also have to report by June 1, 2025 on how the program will be implemented and its estimated costs.
